actions.action: Consume the Phase 3 learning that agent context and downstream decisions must be evidence-backed, bounded, deterministic, and capable of abstaining.
Add a canonical routing-decision contract that separates executor recommendation from execution authority and retains raw profile metrics with source execution IDs.
Implement deterministic agent/model/toolset performance profiling and routing with minimum-sample, tie, future-state, and HALT exclusion controls.
Add clearly marked synthetic comparison data for unit testing without representing it as a real benchmark or production result.
Add positive and negative routing tests for deterministic selection, minimum samples, material ties, future/HALT exclusion, evidence traceability, and live-history abstention.
Integrate optional routing into the existing runner without changing directive authority or execution_authorized=false.
Run the generalized Leverage Engine regression gate, DiffWall, and repository-map validation on PR #49.

changes.change_summary: Added deterministic evidence-backed executor profiling and routing.
Added canonical authority-neutral routing recommendation contract.
Added routing selection and abstention coverage including live-history behavior.
Added test-only synthetic executor histories explicitly marked as non-benchmark sample data.
Added opt-in routing decision output while preserving execution_authorized=false.

operator_interventions.reason: Pre-authorized bounded workahead and merges through the final planned phase.
operator_interventions.effect: Phase 4 may merge after acceptance validation; routing itself remains recommendation-only and cannot dispatch agents or expand authority.

review_events.rationale: Operator pre-authorized planned workahead; Phase 4 regression, DiffWall, and repository-map validation all pass.

friction: Current real execution history is insufficient to meet the three-sample threshold for any single agent+model+toolset profile, so live routing correctly abstains.
Treating the complete receipt tools list as executor identity can fragment history when validation or observability tooling changes even if the underlying agent/model remains the same.

reusable_learnings.learning: Performance-aware routing should abstain until a declared minimum evidence threshold is met and must remain a recommendation separate from execution authority.

Executor identity needs an explicit stable capability toolset distinct from incidental validation and observability tools; otherwise performance history fragments across operationally equivalent runs.

Synthetic routing fixtures are useful for proving deterministic selection logic only when they are explicitly quarantined from production benchmark claims and live decisions remain grounded in real retained receipts.

reused_experience.statement: Governed context compilation should be refusal-first: admission requires explicit relevance, freshness, relation consistency, and budget fit, with every exclusion carrying a deterministic reason.
reused_experience.application: Phase 4 applies the same refusal-first posture to executor selection: minimum samples and material ties produce REVIEW instead of a guessed winner.
reused_experience.observed_effect: The live-history unit test passes only when current insufficient evidence abstains rather than selecting an executor.

reused_experience.statement: Regression infrastructure should trigger on the subsystem boundary rather than on phase-specific files; otherwise later compounding increments can silently escape the validation spine.
reused_experience.application: Phase 4 required no new CI work; the generalized Leverage Engine regression workflow automatically executed the new routing tests and the complete existing suite.
reused_experience.observed_effect: A five-file Phase 4 increment received full subsystem regression coverage without another protected workflow change.

residual_risks: Real routing history is still too small for an evidence-backed executor selection at the configured production threshold.
Executor identity currently uses the entire receipt tool list rather than a separately declared stable capability toolset.
No duration, token, compute-cost, or artifact-quality metric is yet normalized into routing profiles.
Routing is recommendation-only and is not yet consumed by a governed execution packet or dispatcher.
gate_reasons: full Leverage Engine regression suite passes

next_improvement.objective: Build the Phase 5 environment-improvement loop that mines retained friction, failures, exclusions, routing abstentions, and reusable learning for recurring structural bottlenecks, produces an evidence-backed improvement proposal, and never self-authorizes the resulting change.
next_improvement.rationale: The system can now retain experience, compile context, and evaluate executor evidence. The final planned phase should turn recurring operational friction into bounded infrastructure-improvement proposals so the environment can systematically improve itself.
